questions.text: Do you want your character to cast spells?
answers: Yes: magic is the heart of who they are
A touch of the mystical, but no spells
a Shugenja School is never a best match, mystic +2, spirits and the dead +1, monster hunter +1, Monk +2, Shugenja -3
No: they rely on their own skill
a Shugenja School is never a best match, mystic -1, Shugenja -3

questions.text: How much rules detail do you want to keep track of?
answers: Keep it simple: I am still learning the game
Lots of moving parts: I like mastering a system

questions.text: How do you feel about unusual characters?
answers: A classic samurai most players will recognise
Open to something a bit different
Common +1, Uncommon +2, Unusual +0, adds a "something different" pick
Common -1, Uncommon +1, Unusual +3, adds a "something different" pick

questions.text: When trouble starts, what does your character reach for first?
answers: Words: persuasion, wit or a well-placed secret
Inner discipline and their own two hands
The shadows: they would rather not be seen

questions.text: In a fight, where do you want to be?
answers: In the front line, taking hits and hitting back harder
Facing one opponent: a single perfect strike
At a distance, with a bow
Fast and mobile: strike and get away

questions.text: Away from a fight, how do they get their way?
answers: Secrets, leverage and a little fear
Evidence: they find out the truth

questions.text: What should their magic be best at?
answers: Speaking with spirits, ancestors and the dead
Water: adaptable, healing and always moving
Void: the rare, mystical space between

questions.text: What would they most like to be remembered for?
answers: Standing between the Empire and the darkness
Perfect mastery of an art: the sword, the brush or the stage
Victory: battles won and enemies broken
Wisdom: understanding the secrets of the world
Loyalty in the shadows: doing what others will not
Freedom: going where no one else has been

questions.text: Where do they feel most at home?
answers: On a great wall, facing a monster-haunted wasteland
At sea, among islands and ports
On the road, never in one place for long

questions.text: Would they break the rules to get the job done?
answers: Never: their word and their honour are everything
Only if there is truly no other way
Yes, if the result is worth it

questions.text: Which virtue of Bushido matters most to them?
answers: front line +2, monster hunter +2, all-out attacker +1
None of them: results matter more
Deeply: prayer and meditation shape their life
mystic +3, spirits and the dead +2, Monk +1
Not very: steel and results matter more

questions.text: Who or what would you like at their side?
answers: A hunting falcon or a war-cat
A fine blade, their family's pride

questions.text: Every samurai thinks about how they will die. How will yours?
answers: In a last stand, holding the line
Fighting the darkness, far from home
Of old age, surrounded by students
Quietly, with secrets no one ever learns
At the head of an army
Somewhere no one from home has ever been
